evidence.quote: The speed and intensity of this downturn – and the rapidity of the recovery in many areas – are without modern precedent.
Business plans have been reworked, outlooks have been revised, and the future continues to be tinged with uncertainty.
Its original purpose was to elicit broad feedback as part of our monetary policy framework review.
